verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is an API-bearing SaaS ATS, so scoped API credentials are a fair question. The evidence pack documents Harvest, Job Board, Assessment and Ingestion APIs, plus an audit log and a developer sandbox. None of it mentions issuing API keys with per-endpoint permissions, scopes, or least-privilege controls for an agent. Audit logs and sandboxes are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
